verses.text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
verses.emlaei: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
verses.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience
verses.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri
